name: Plugin Card
description: Draggable/resizable card widget — the fundamental UI container for all plugins. Renders a card with canvas-rendered title header (via @chenglou/pretext for proper text layout), minimize/fit-viewport/terminate control buttons, body area for plugin content, and E/S/SE edge resize handles. Drag snaps to 28px grid via world-to-screen coordinate transform. Resize snaps to 28px increments with 280px minimum. Double-click header fits viewport. UUID via crypto.randomUUID(). Supports setContent() for canvas-rendered body text.

interface.constructor: new PluginCard(parent: HTMLElement, opts: CardOptions, getTransform: () => { scale, panX, panY })

options.name: title
options.description: Card title displayed in header canvas

options.name: onDragStart
options.description: Called when drag begins with client coords

options.name: onDragMove
options.description: Called during drag with client coords

options.name: onDragEnd
options.description: Called when drag completes with snapped world coords

options.name: onResizeEnd
options.description: Called when resize completes with new dimensions

options.name: onFocus
options.description: Called on any mousedown inside card

options.name: onFitViewport
options.description: Called when fit-viewport button or header double-click

options.name: onHeaderContextMenu
options.description: Called on right-click of header area

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Redraw the title on header canvas using @chenglou/pretext

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Replace body content with canvas-rendered text

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Fire onDestroy callback and remove DOM element
